idea: Basic plumbing maintenance every homeowner should know
title: Simple Routine Checks to Protect Your Home Plumbing
description: Taking care of your home plumbing does not require complex tools or expert skills. A few basic routines can save you from costly repairs down the road. Start by knowing the location of your main water shutoff valve so you can act quickly during an emergency. Inspect exposed pipes under sinks and near your water heater monthly for slow leaks or white corrosion. Clean drain strainers regularly to prevent stubborn clogs, and avoid pouring grease down the kitchen sink. Finally, test your toilet flappers yearly to ensure you are not wasting water. These quick visual checks make a huge difference in preserving your home.
